artworks.title: Telemachus Departing from Nestor
artworks.description: Howard's departure — Telemachus leaving Nestor's hospitality for Sparta, the Pylos visit closing in farewell.

artworks.title: Telemachus and Nestor Embracing
artworks.description: Dutch embrace — Telemachus and Nestor, the old counsellor's welcome that Homer makes the foil to every wrecked return.

artworks.title: Telemachus Visits Nestor at Pylos

popCulture.title: Nestor
